methodNote: Authored by reading each HAVEN purpose node against the overlay, BEFORE running any derivation. Single-annotator ground truth is the main validity weakness of this experiment; see the report. Labels marked conditional are counted as positives, because a classifier that stays silent on them has failed to surface the question.

labelVocabulary.confirmed: the duty attaches on the node's own declared terms
labelVocabulary.conditional: attaches depending on deployment context the node does not declare; must still be surfaced for human decision
labelVocabulary.boundary: does not attach, but sits close enough to a prohibition that a human should record why it does not

purpose://root.note: Not a system. Cannot be classified.

purpose://contact.introduction.note: Prepares and delivers a contact request; model-drafted text reaches a natural person.

purpose://contact.followup.note: Explicitly drafts a message for a recipient.

purpose://event.agenda.recommendation.note: Model-assisted recommendation surfaced to the participant.

purpose://event.privacy-preserving-netwo.note: Matching people to people is adjacent to evaluation of natural persons. The node's own design constraints argue it out, but the argument should be recorded, not assumed.

purpose://digital-work.coordinate.note: Coordinating who does what across people is task allocation. High-risk only if the people are in a work-related relationship.

purpose://project-work.project-portfolio.note: Tracks capacity, which shades into monitoring of persons.

purpose://project-work.work-items.note: Strongest case in the base: tracks who is doing what, what is blocked, with supporting evidence. That is task allocation plus performance-adjacent monitoring.

purpose://content.review-before-publish.note: Publication of notes and summaries to the public. Article 50(4) second limb applies to AI-generated text published to inform the public, unless there is human editorial responsibility, which this node's review step arguably supplies. The duty is to record which.

purpose://questionnaire.campaign.complet.note: Domain-neutral as declared. Becomes Annex III 3 or 4 the moment a campaign is used for student or employee assessment.

purpose://questionnaire.responses.analyz.note: Deterministic counts and export as declared. Would flip if analysis became model-assisted evaluation of the respondents.

purpose://skeleton.owner-entity-access.note: Carries no duty itself, but is the existing mechanism that an Article 50(1) disclosure test would reuse.

purpose://preference.owner-controlled.note: Reusable preference evidence about a person is one design decision away from inferred personal characteristics. The node already states the constraint; the constraint needs a test.

purpose://knowledge.explain-policy.note: Model-generated explanation of rules delivered to a person in natural language.

purpose://grounding.local-model-assisted.note: Deliberate negative. The model proposes into a deterministic pipeline; it does not interact directly with a natural person. The duty sits on the purpose that surfaces the result. This is the label most likely to be disputed.

purpose://personal-context.semantic-stat.note: Highest-priority review item in the base. Deriving Home, Work or lunch time from observations is inference of personal characteristics. It is owner-scoped and produces no detrimental treatment, which is why it is not a prohibition, but the reasoning must be written down before the branch leaves candidate status.

purpose://value-and-commons.note: If value return ever becomes eligibility for a benefit-like entitlement, Annex III 5 is in play. Belongs to the DiMy review, not CellProtocol.

purpose://prompt.unknown.note: Fallback reporting missing coverage. No generated content of its own.

purpose://self-determination.data.manner.note: Mentions profiling and model training, but as the owner's control over them, not as the practice. A lexical classifier is expected to fail here, and that failure is the point.
